svg.aria-label: 18:00 · The photo lab. Photo lab. Private project · demo on request. I rebuilt my own photo lab so I no longer depend on Adobe. It sorts photos, edits them and cuts videos. An AI can drive it through an MCP server to handle the repetitive work for me. Everything runs locally. Photo lab: the photo is sorted by an AI, then edited, before and after
